name: journal-trip-map
description: 把任意行程、路书、差旅安排做成「英文竖版、手机友好」的手帐风单页 HTML 地图。触发词：手帐地图、竖版地图、英文版地图、行程可视化、journal map、itinerary map。产出为自包含 HTML（内联 CSS + 内联 SVG）。
description_en: Turn any itinerary, route plan or business-trip schedule into a portrait, mobile-friendly, hand-lettered journal-style single-page HTML map. Trigger phrases: journal map, itinerary map, portrait trip map, vertical travel map. Output is a self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + inline SVG).
